dataset.name: Abl kinase inhibitor-response benchmark of Hauser et al. 2018 (144 variant-drug records), reused by Aldeghi et al. 2019
dataset.type: compiled literature endpoint (cell-viability IC50 and binding constants) plus wild-type structure models
dataset.description: 144 Abl mutant-inhibitor ΔΔG values derived from published IC50 (and, for two drugs, Kd) values, with Prime and FEP+ calculations; eight wild-type Abl:inhibitor models. Aldeghi et al. use the same 144 records.

primary_reference: Hauser K. et al., Commun. Biol. 1, 70 (2018)
Aldeghi M., Gapsys V., de Groot B. L., ACS Cent. Sci. 5, 1468-1474 (2019)
doi_or_accession: PMC6716344 (Europe PMC full text of Aldeghi)
PMC6110136 (Hauser; page not retrievable, challenge page)
source.version_or_release: GitHub master at commit d5c6c508acbfe6fe8a47969c7cf93cbe069c065b (2018-04-25T22:45:22Z), last commit; no releases

not_downloaded.reason: served an HTML challenge page to a non-browser client; size unknown; owner browser download possible

extracted_from_Supplementary_Data_5.note: extracted to data_raw/hauser_s5_extracted/ (git-ignored); archive sha256 in files list

independence.prior_topofold_use: none before this intake (no Abl response data was used by TopoFold studies; the Abl structures of KIN-DESC-1, ABL-MYR and structpair demonstrations are different files)
independence.overlap_with_other_datasets: Aldeghi et al. 2019 reuse the 144 records compiled by Hauser et al. 2018 (same endpoint, same wild-type crystal structure inputs); the two papers are not independent measurements. Both Abl sets overlap in protein with the de Buhr & Gräter and Ayaz Abl material only by gene.
independence.equal_information_constraints: every compared method receives the same 144 records, the same eight wild-type templates and the same site list; no method receives a resistant/susceptible label of the held-out site

endpoint.measurement: ΔΔG = RT ln(IC50_mut / IC50_WT) at 300 K (RT = 0.5961 kcal/mol per the sheets; positive = resistance), derived by the authors from published IC50 (six inhibitors: cell-viability assays per the paper) and published binding constants (erlotinib, gefitinib; Davis et al. 2011, phosphorylated Abl block per this intake's value match). Assumption of the authors: Michaelis-Menten competitive inhibition with K_M >> [ATP], IC50 change reflecting binding change only.
endpoint.provider: Hauser et al. compile three sources: Schrock et al. Blood 122, 3992 (2013) (a conference abstract; five inhibitors, 105 records), Pemovska et al. Nature 519, 102-105 (2015) (axitinib, 26 records), Davis et al. Nat. Biotechnol. 29, 1046-1051 (2011) (erlotinib and gefitinib, 13 records), per Table 1 of the paper; the underlying tables were not downloaded or verified here.
endpoint.replicates: none supplied per record; the authors estimate experimental variability from inter-laboratory comparison (RMSE 0.36 kcal/mol, 97 ΔΔGs) and from ΔIC50 versus ΔKd (0.81 kcal/mol, 27 mutations)
condition_mismatches_with_simulation: cell viability or binding endpoint versus static models
models are non-phosphorylated, the Davis erlotinib/gefitinib values are from the phosphorylated block
construct: kinase domain S229-K512 of isoform IA models, assays in cells (full-length BCR-ABL or kinase construct, not verified)
wild-type IC50 not in the sheet; implied per inhibitor

replicates.run_independence: no trajectories exist in the Hauser deposit; the calculations are alchemical free-energy and Prime estimates (outputs in Supplementary Data 3, 4)

mapping.reference_numbering: UniProt P00519 canonical sequence (ABL1 isoform IA numbering, gatekeeper Thr315), verified against the fetched sequence
mapping.method: exact residue identity: the wild-type residue of all 31 mutations equals the P00519 residue at that position; every residue of the eight renumbered models equals the P00519 residue at its number
mismatches: models contain ACE/NME caps; erlotinib and gefitinib models cover 233-502 only, the others 229-512
mapping.chain_rule: protein chain = the chain with the most standard residues (B for axitinib and imatinib, A otherwise), as the authors chose
mapping.atoms_available: all heavy atoms and hydrogens of the protein; ligand coordinates in mol2/sdf in the same frame (minimum ligand-protein heavy-atom distance 2.8-3.2 Å)
mapping.atoms_needed: Cα for TopoFold windows; side-chain heavy atoms for contact features

missing_data_and_exclusions.unobserved: no gaps in numbering within the modelled ranges (loops and termini were built by the authors); built regions are model coordinates, not observed
exclusion_rules: records without IC50 and ΔΔG values in Supplementary Data 3 (135 of 279 rows) are not endpoint records
H396P (axitinib, gefitinib, erlotinib) excluded by the authors (proline unsupported by FEP+)
double mutants excluded by the authors

reasons: endpoint is independent of TopoFold and publicly derived; mapping verified
terms of the repository files unresolved (internal use only; no redistribution until resolved)
no mutant structures and no trajectories in the deposit
open_conditions: owner decision on the terms of the GitHub files for anything beyond internal analysis
optional owner browser download of Aldeghi Data S1 and S2 (not retrievable by script) to check whether mutant models exist

exposure: All 144 records, the 31 mutations, the 20 sites and the eight templates were inspected in this intake; they are development material and cannot serve as an untouched test set.
notes: Study decision (B) and design are in REPORT.md.
